text:
zoe: quick flag — eu1 /generate errors rising, noticed after the late-afternoon push. Seeing customer timeouts. Need quick mitigation.

deploy-bot: [deploy-bot] Alert: eu1 5xx=11.6% over 6m; canary fraction=9%. Recent image: 2026-03-22-3.2.1. Suggested: region-pin or rollback. Runbook: https://go/redwood/runbooks/rollback
maria: can we do a soft regional rollback (image revert) or region-pin the previous model? Prefer pin to limit churn.
dennis: triage quick logs: `inference_core.cc: GPU_ALLOC_FAIL; kvcache miss floods` — tail latency correlated.
ops-lead: policy: >10% 5xx => mitigate. Approve expedited region pin to last-known-good (3.1.9). Skip canary to speed recovery. Notify CS.
zoe: issuing pin now:
```
/deploy pin model-redwood-3.1.9 --region eu1 --skip-canary --reason "post-deploy 5xx spike" --ticket INC-3523
```
deploy-bot: command received from zoe. Preflight OK. Beginning regional pin: rolling to 100% in eu1 with short ramp.
maria: running a 15-case smoke set now.
maria: smoke: outputs sane, latency back near baseline, no 5xx in smoke. :white_check_mark:
deploy-bot: Pin complete at 21:15:30 UTC. model-redwood-3.1.9 active in eu1. 5xx rolling avg now 0.9% over 3m.
releasebot: Draft note queued: "Regional pin: eu1 -> v3.1.9 to mitigate elevated 5xx after v3.2.1 push. Investigation in progress; postmortem to be filed (INC-3523)." PR: https://go/redwood/prs/5299
cs: Notified — prepping customer blurb about minor output diffs if any.
ops-lead: good containment. Keep region pinned for 2h and collect GPU heap + kvcache traces. Assign owners for postmortem.
zoe: filed INC-3523 and assigned follow-ups. Closing fast-path unless we see regression. Thanks everyone.
